items.text: OUT-001 covers all four required panel interactions and maps their workflow, catalog, proposal, standing/record and loop-event inputs to the responsible definitions and host objects/results; unresolved inputs are explicit. Verify with VER-001. Grounds: REQ-001, CLM-001, CLM-002.

verification.text: Inspect OUT-001 against D/SOW-019 and P/V4-HOST-04; trace conversation, workflow selection, proposal queue and checks individually to CLM-002 input definitions, host objects/results and responsible receiving participants. Record the exact supplied definitions or missing inputs. This checks interface completeness, not host implementation.

items.text: Panel-to-table cases show work, proposals with affected objects/old/new values/reason, and referenced check findings in host-owned tables/views with their source standing, basis and receipt/outcome links, without an agent-private result surface or alternate mutation route. Verify with VER-002. Grounds: REQ-002.

verification.text: Exercise or specify candidate-bound panel-to-host-view cases for a proposed edit and an agent check. Inspect affected rows, old/new values, reason, basis, outcomes, receipt references and result standing against the consumed catalog/proposal contracts; confirm check findings reference rows/results without themselves changing the tables. Include an attempted detached agent-private result or bypass route as a rejection case. Until the external candidate exists, label these designed/unexecuted; cite H/V4-HI-10–25 and E/V4-EXM-20–21.

items.text: Receiving cases preserve distinct execution and human-act evidence, accept terminology for proposal decisions, faithful recording of actual human acts with actor/recorder distinction, and visible lapse when bound content changes; false attribution and inferences from success, queueing or another act fail. Unruled policy stays explicit. Verify with VER-003. Grounds: REQ-003, CLM-004.

verification.text: Use the adopted human-act/record contract to examine separate traces for execution success, queued proposals, actual acceptance/application, agent findings and evidenced human checking/approval/reliance. Reject fabricated human acts and cross-act promotion. Include a positive actual human act faithfully recorded by an agent/host recorder with actor, evidence and bound content preserved, plus an independently evidenced human act without inferred prior proposal acceptance. Confirm proposal text says accept and changed bound content lapses visibly. Leave operation-specific unruled policy cases pending their accepted decision; cite H/V4-HI-25, 30–42 and 70–71, B/decision 03 and P/V4-AUT-01–05.

items.text: OUT-002 identifies actual consumer responsibilities and records whether common components are agreed or still open; OI-013 and OI-014 retain their separate owners and exact points of need, and host construction stays external. Verify with VER-004. Grounds: REQ-004, REQ-006, CLM-003.

verification.text: Compare the allocation account to D anticipated artifacts, C, A/V4-ARC-20 and I/OI-013/OI-014. Inspect the repeated purpose, actual consumers, agreement evidence or unresolved allocation, external ownership, and exact owner/timing for each issue. Do not infer agreement from authored files.

items.text: OUT-003 accounts for the required interaction, visibility and standing cases, identifies the checked interfaces and external inputs used, and distinguishes defined cases from executed candidate-bound host evidence; unavailable input, unexecuted cases and dependent open decisions remain visible. Verify with VER-005. Grounds: REQ-005, CLM-005.

verification.text: Review the receiving-case inventory for AC-001 through AC-003 coverage, consumed-definition identity, candidate/evidence binding and actual external contribution. Compare pending cases to DEP-001 and P/OQ-11. Record what is defined, executed, limited or awaiting input; a missing host or policy input is not a passed conformance case. This is case-accounting evidence for AC-005, not independent execution of the other criteria.

items.text: Any OUT-004 component is limited to a selected contribution with an actual responsibility/receiving agreement and demonstrable conformance to the panel contract; if no such allocation is agreed, its conditional implementation is recorded as unresolved, with no fabricated code completion or host commitment. Verify with VER-006. Grounds: REQ-004, CLM-003.

verification.text: If common panel construction has an actual agreed allocation, inspect the component and receiving evidence against that exact selected responsibility and the applicable OUT-001 contract. Otherwise verify the recorded conditional state, unresolved owner allocation and point of need without marking implementation complete. Cite D, C, A/V4-ARC-20 and I/OI-013/OI-014.

items.text: The deliverable assigns each excluded act to the owner named in CLM-001 through CLM-005, retains its local receiving obligations, and makes no claim that contract initialization establishes implementation, external delivery/adoption, a human act or professional reliance. Verify with VER-007. Grounds: REQ-006, CLM-005.

verification.text: Review every excluded act in REQ-006 one-for-one against its cited claim and source owner. Run schema and boundary-owner validation, then semantically inspect external/human owners beyond the tool's deliverable-ID grammar. Confirm scoped receiving work, truthful evidence standing and no external or policy-owner substitution; cite D, I, B/J and O, H §1 and O.
